messages:
Maria (Sales Eng): Hey team — AcmeCorp POC: when they enable tool calls + strict schema validation we're seeing repeated SchemaValidationError + intermittent 429s. They blocked on this for the demo later today. Can we swarm?
Alex (AE): Heard — they're on the trial plan with 2 concurrent seats. Demo at 3pm PT.
Sam (Infra Eng): pinging logs now. Any repro steps?
Maria (Sales Eng): Steps: send chat completion with `tools: [{name: 'lookup_customer'}]` and `response_format: {type: 'json', schema: {...}}`. The model sometimes returns quoted JSON string instead of object. Example error from their logs: `SchemaValidationError: expected object, got string` followed by `request_id=rs-79c2`.
Jess (Support): Also saw 429s right after the schema error spikes. Looks like client retried sync which pushed them over the per-minute quota. Can you paste the exact request payload?
Maria (Sales Eng): Sure — payload snippet:
```
{
  "model": "redwood-1",
  "json_mode": true,
  "tools": ["customer_lookup"],
  "prompt": "Retrieve customer info and output JSON matching the schema",
  "max_tokens": 400
}
```
Sam (Infra Eng): Thanks. Two things to triage in parallel: (1) why model returns JSON as string; (2) throttling from aggressive client retries.
Alex (AE): Customer asked about pricing if we need to enable dedicated capacity to avoid throttles — they want cost ballpark.
Jess (Support): For immediate unblock, we can increase their burst quota for the trial org to avoid 429s during demo. Sam, can you elevate them to a temporary 3x burst?
Sam (Infra Eng): I can do a one-hour quota bump for org `acme-trial-231`. Will do now. Deploy Bot: executed quota change.
Deploy Bot: Quota update applied for `acme-trial-231`: +200 r/min for 60 minutes.
Maria (Sales Eng): Nice — that should keep the demo from being rate-limited. Back to schema: suspected cause is when the tool call returns a stringified JSON as `result` value. The structured-output validator isn't forgiving.
Sam (Infra Eng): We can add a pre-validate step in the serving path to attempt `JSON.parse` on string payloads when `json_mode` is true. Quick patch on the sidecar would coerce quoted JSON into objects.
Jess (Support): Temporary customer workaround: ask their integrator to set `strip_wrapping_quotes: true` or postprocess the `result` with `JSON.parse` before sending to the validator.
Alex (AE): I'll relay the workaround. Also they raised security questionnaire items — they need network isolation and SOC2. Maria, can you share SecQ Bot's link?
SecQ Bot: Sec questionnaire status: `acme-trial-231` — basic answers filled. Private deployment / Dedicated requested. Contact: enterprise-sales@redwood.ai.
Maria (Sales Eng): Thanks. I noted Dedicated capacity pricing is around $Xk/mo for the baseline GPU pool — will follow up with exact quote.
Sam (Infra Eng): Patch plan: (A) short-term: add string-to-json coercion on response when `json_mode` or `response_format` present; (B) longer-term: improve the schema validator to accept JSON strings and attempt parse (configurable). I can ship A as a hotfix to staging in ~40m, prod after validation.
Jess (Support): Need logs to correlate. Maria, can you forward `request_id` from customer when the sample fails?
Maria (Sales Eng): Sent `rs-79c2` and `rs-79d0` in DM to Sam.
Sam (Infra Eng): Got them. Investigating now — initial trace shows tool subprocess returned `"{\"id\":123,\"email\":\"x@acme.com\"}"` (string). Sidecar didn't coerce, validator rejected.
Alex (AE): If we push the hotfix, will there be any change in semantics that could affect other customers?
Sam (Infra Eng): Coercion is opt-in: only when `json_mode=true` OR `response_format.type==\"json\"`. Safe default. We'll add feature flag.
Jess (Support): I'll mark this P1 for the POC flow and own communications.
Maria (Sales Eng): Customer update: told them we're patching and temporarily increased quota. They accepted. :thumbsup:
Alex (AE): Thanks — also capture in the deal notes: blocker was structured output + retries; mitigation: quota bump + hotfix; enterprise ask: Dedicated & SOC2.
Maria (Sales Eng): Next steps: Sam to post PR link + ETA, Jess to send status update to customer, Alex to follow up on pricing + contract.
Sam (Infra Eng): PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/serving/pulls/2213 — adds JSON coercion & feature flag. ETA for staging deploy: 40m.
Jess (Support): I'll send the update now and include temporary workaround.
Maria (Sales Eng): Great team — keeping demo on. I'll close the loop after the demo.
Alex (AE): Awesome. :rocket:
Jess (Support): Leaving follow-up checklist here: 
- escalate if 429s persist after quota bump
- validate PR in staging with acme testcases
- attach sec questionnaire answers to deal folder

Maria (Sales Eng): Adding those to the deal doc. Thanks everyone.
